attrs.text: Round 2 asserted that 'if any federated relation can pin a variable to a value, 1PA fails outright'. THAT IS FALSE, and it was the sentence the practical question was built on. Over D = {0,1} a language whose only pin is x = 0 realizes projections {0} and {0,1}, which intersect — so it pins a value AND has 1PA. Failure needs two DISJOINT projections, e.g. pp-defining both {0} and {1}. Both cases are now checked in §4. Correction from GPT-5.6's round-2 audit.
